purpose: Teach: 陽子/高山/高松/佐賀/島根/日本橋/水田/淵

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お孫様の陽子ちゃんを連れていらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer brought her granddaughter Yoko with her today.
lines.style: Soft, observant tone. Noticing something small and generous. Warm mention of the child. Slight lift at the end, sharing something gentle.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、飛騨高山の古民家カフェのお話を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer told us all about her little café in the old farmhouse up in Hida-Takayama.
lines.style: Engaged listening, slight wonder in the voice. Recall of a story that moved her. Conversational, like she's been turning it over in her mind.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、高松のオリーブ農園に行かれたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: She said she visits the olive groves in Takamatsu.
lines.style: Gentle noting of detail. Quiet admiration underneath. A small pause before speaking, like gathering the thread of the story.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、佐賀の有田焼を集めてらっしゃるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: And she collects Arita ware from Saga — builds a whole collection, apparently.
lines.style: Slight impressed tone. Matter-of-fact but with undertone of respect for the dedication. Light conversational rhythm.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、島根のしじみ漁師さんと縁があるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: She has ties to clam fishermen down in Shimane, too.
lines.style: Quieter here. Connecting the threads. Like she's assembling a picture of this person's world. Wondering tone.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、日本橋のお店との取引のお話を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: She was telling us about her business dealings with a shop in Nihonbashi.
lines.style: Present tense of recall. Voice carries the weight of a life's work being described. Steady, almost reverent in the listening.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ご実家が水田に囲まれた農家だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Her home is surrounded by rice paddies — she grew up on a farm.
lines.style: Grounding detail. Foundational. Like understanding where someone comes from. Quiet respect for the roots.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、子供時代に川の淵で泳いだお話を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: She was telling us how she used to swim in the river pools when she was a child.
lines.style: Wistful, gentle recall. Drawing out the memory as if seeing it herself. Soft close, trailing into quiet reflection.
